title: Record a take
goal: Play the whole arrangement from the top and record it to WAV in the Record tab.
explain: A take is the finished arrangement played once, start to finish. Make sure the check is clean first: an error means the browser keeps playing the previous version. Add a short outro so the take ends instead of stopping dead, for example the drums alone for 8 bars. Then open the Record tab, press record, start playback from bar 1 and stop after the last section; the take is saved with the song.
try_prompt: Add an 8-bar outro with just the drums and filtered chords, check that everything passes, and tell me when the song is ready to record.
